title: Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering
excerpt: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful method for guiding the behavior of generative models towards desired outcomes such as toxicity mitigation. However, most existing methods apply interventions uniformly across all inputs, degrading model performance when steering is unnecessary. We introduce Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering (DSAS), a method-agnostic steering framework that decouples when to steer from how to steer. DSAS adaptively modulates the strength of existing steering transformations across layers and inputs, intervening strongly only when undesired behavior is detected…

ai.summary: Apple ML researchers introduced Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering (DSAS), a framework that adaptively adjusts steering strength per input to improve generative model control without hurting performance.
ai.why: Provides a plug‑in method for developers to apply selective safety or style steering to large language models.
